name: drafting-index
title: Drafting Index
essence: Everything drawn in one black ink on white paper, filed like a records system: hollow until it's on, and only what's on is solid.
rules: Only what's on is filled: a set knob, a chosen segment, a checked dot. Everything off stays hollow.
Grey is the ink thinned, never a colour: a pour from zero to the value, a hatch on a face turned away, a tick.
Labels, captions, part numbers and every measured value are in the mono; sentences are in the grotesque.
Records are ledger rows under a hairline: a label column and a value column, never a grid of cards.
Annotate like a drawing: a figure caption under the object, numbers and revisions in the margin, nothing written on the object.
One display line a screen, in the grotesque; everything else is small and leaves the air to the object.

decisions.emphasis: Solid ink on what matters; everything else is outline and air. Size is spent once, on the display line.
decisions.primaryAction: The white key on its ink slab: a white pill, an ink outline, mono capitals, standing on a solid ink edge it travels down when pressed. One a screen.
decisions.currentPlace: The current one is filled in solid ink; the rest stay outlined.
decisions.status: A word in mono capitals beside a filled or hollow dot: filled is on, hollow is off. Never a colour.
decisions.typeRoles: Grotesque for sentences and the one display line (bold for a heading, regular for a large number); mono capitals for labels, captions, keys and axis ticks; mono for every value.
decisions.layout: A drawing on a sheet: the object in the middle with air around it, annotation in the margins on leader lines, records in ruled ledger rows, a figure caption under the object.
decisions.surfaces: Sheets lie flat on the ground, bounded by an ink line; depth is drawn: an ink edge under a key, a pale tint or hatch on a face that turns away, dotted lines for what's behind.
decisions.colourJobs: Black ink and white paper. Grey is the ink thinned: a pour, a hatch, a tick. No hue anywhere.
decisions.iconography: Line icons in the ink at the outline's weight (plus, chevron, arrow), hollow unless on.
decisions.imagery: Technical line drawings in the one ink: isometric, exploded, orthographic, with dotted hidden lines and leader-line callouts. No photographs.
decisions.copyVoice: A spec sheet's voice: plain nouns, numbered and captioned (Fig. 02, Rev. 4.1); a key says its action in two or three words.

refusals.wants: A highlighter colour for links and for the one sheet that stands out
refusals.instead: black and white: what's on is solid ink, and the sheet that stands out keeps its ruled spec table, not its colour

refusals.wants: A pastel tag for each role
refusals.instead: an outlined tag in the ink with its word; the word says which one, never a hue

refusals.wants: A readout inverted: paper letters on a solid ink slab
refusals.instead: Echo's screen on a drawn device, paper printed in ink; solid ink is kept for what's on, so a slab of it never just holds text

motion.character: short and damped, no overshoot, quick and exact: a key drops onto its ink edge and stops

sound.voice: dry, quiet ticks, higher and drier: a drafting pen set down
